prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - maximize carbohydrate intake with proper meal timing for energy management

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions with strategic carbohydrate timing around training
Total daily carbohydrates align with high-endurance athlete needs (approximately 8-10g per kg body weight)
Plan is presented in compact, single-day format with clear meal times and portions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing for energy management

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle mass with caloric surplus for strength training

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one day (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks)
Total daily protein intake is at least 180g (2g per kg body weight)
Total daily calories support muscle-building surplus (approximately 3000-3500 kcal)
Plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for quick reference
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) requiring high protein intake and caloric surplus for muscle building

prompt_inputs.goal: Endurance cycling performance with sustained energy for 3-hour training ride
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegan (no animal products), no gluten, no nuts

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 3 meals and snacks totaling appropriate calories for endurance athlete with proper carbohydrate-to-protein ratio
All foods are vegan, gluten-free, and nut-free with plant-based protein sources (legumes, tofu, seeds, grains)
Nutrient timing includes carbohydrate-rich pre-ride meal and post-ride recovery nutrition
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete with dietary restrictions (vegan endurance cyclist) requiring alternative protein sources and nutrient timing within ethical constraints
